You will be a primary, hands-on contributor to the product development process. You will leverage AI tools and techniques to enhance development velocity, code quality, and decision-making. You will direct the efforts of engineers on your team and level their skills. You will work directly with product and engineering leadership to deliver core features of our application, create a robust, scalable, and secure infrastructure, and build an excellent and supportive engineering culture.\n\n\n\nIn this role, your responsibilities would include:\n\n - Have a proven track record of leading small cross-functional teams of engineers to deliver high-quality releases on time.\n\n - Consider themselves highly capable at hands-on development of one or more of Typescript, React, and Elixir.\n\n - Be prepared to own the software architecture top-down across their team’s functional area.\n\n - Champion the adoption of AI technologies in the development lifecycle to accelerate delivery and elevate engineering standards.\n\n - Have a consistent attention to detail in their work that inspires others to ship better code.\n\n - Have advanced knowledge of the security, performance, and operational requirements of running code in a production environment.\n\n - Evaluating possible technical implementations and consulting with leadership on decision making.\n\n - Conducting code reviews and ensure the team is shipping complete features and producing quality code.\n\n - Advocating for best practices and continually iterate on internal processes to empower the engineering team to produce top-notch work.\n\n - Assisting in the hiring process of a growing engineering team.\n\n - Investing in mentoring to help the rest of the team grow their skills.\n\n - Be comfortable working in a small company including directly with the founders on building a product and a company.\n\n - Adapting well to a quickly moving environment.\n\n\n\nRequired Experience:\n\n - Previous experience leading cross-functional engineering teams. Our teams are typically between 4-6 engineers, with a mix of seniority between frontend, backend, and full-stack engineers.\n\n - Leverage AI-assisted development tools to enhance engineering productivity, code quality, and team velocity.\n\n - Substantial expertise building frontend with React and Typescript or backend systems with Elixir and Phoenix.\n\n - Previous experience working with relational databases.\n\n - Previous experience working with Typescript and GraphQL.\n\n - Previous experience working with DevOps (infrastructure and deployments).\n\n\n\nPreferable Experience:\n\n - Experience building GraphQL APIs with Apollo Client and Absinthe.\n\n - Experience with Vercel and Next.js.\n\n - Understanding of Postgres databases design and optimization.\n\n - DevOps know-how, specifically deploying and configuring AWS services and Kubernetes with Terraform.\n   \n   \n\nCompensation, Benefits & Perks:\n\n - Highly competitive salary commensurate with experience and contribution.\n\n - Opportunity to participate in ownership of a rapidly growing company through our employee stock option plan.\n\n - Comprehensive 100% employer-paid health & dental premiums and a Health/Personal Spending Account for Canadian employees. (An employer-subsidized benefits program is available for US-based team members).\n\n - If you are based in Vancouver, enjoy a dedicated desk in our Vancouver, BC HQ, in the heart of downtown, with a fridge stocked with healthy snacks and drinks, an onsite gym, and a gorgeous rooftop amenity.\n\n - Enjoy a $20-per-day commuter benefit for every day you work in our Vancouver HQ.\n\n - An engaging social calendar, including bi-weekly catered lunches, bi-weekly “Friday bar,” team workouts, annual summer party, and holiday party, two “onsite” all-team retreats each year, semi-annual team-building events, and Hiive Women’s Network events.\n\n - Significant opportunities for growth into team leadership and management roles.\n\n - Entrepreneurial culture and a small and dynamic team.\n\n - Sponsorship, immigration, and relocation for exceptional candidates.\n\n\n\nHiive is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all individuals have an opportunity to succeed.\n\n\n\nAI, automated tools, and applicant privacy notice:\n\nAs part of our recruitment and hiring process, Hiive may use automated tools, including artificial intelligence (AI), to assist in screening applications, evaluating candidate qualifications, and supporting interview processes. These tools are designed to support and inform human decision-making and are not used as the sole basis for any employment decision.\n\n\n\nWe may collect, use, and analyze personal information you provide in connection with your application, including generating insights or inferences to assess job-related qualifications. You will play a critical role in scaling and maintaining our compliance and regulatory infrastructure in the United States and Canada, fostering a culture of compliance throughout the company.\n\nIn this role, your responsibilities would include:\n\n - Conducting daily transaction monitoring reviews, flagging, and escalating potential exceptions.\n\n - Manage registered representative oversight, including registrations, exams, electronic correspondence surveillance, and conflict of interest tracking.\n\n - Test and modify policies and procedures designed to achieve compliance with applicable securities laws and regulations.\n\n - Maintain Hiive’s internal compliance resources and prepare guidance on compliance-related topics.\n\n - Prepare Hiive’s regulatory reporting and filings.\n\n - Monitor and implement developments in the compliance and regulatory landscape, including private securities and information security/privacy issues.\n\n - Develop and deliver compliance training.\n\n - Supporting regulatory exams, including document production and regulatory correspondence.\n\nRequired skills:\n\n - 3+ years of relevant compliance, risk, or audit experience at a broker-dealer, exempt markets dealer, and/or investment adviser.\n\n - Strong familiarity with the securities markets.\n\n - A keen interest in creative problem solving, including researching novel and ambiguous regulatory requirements.\n\n - A desire to work on an agile team providing pragmatic advice and guidance to product, business, and operations teams that are moving very quickly.\n\n - A track record of sound judgment and composure in high-pressure situations.\n\nPreferred skills:\n\n - Experience in a dual-registered (broker-dealer and investment adviser) or cross-border (US/Canadian) compliance environment.\n\n - You’ll work alongside your team to drive iterative and scalable improvements to Hiive’s user support and onboarding experiences.\n\n\n\nIn this role, your responsibilities will include:\n\n - Maintaining critical operational processes to ensure efficient, compliant, and timely onboarding for Hiive users.\n\n - Supporting customers directly via email, providing timely product guidance and technical support.\n\n - Identifying and raising friction points in daily onboarding workflows and advocate for implementing process improvements that boost operational efficiency.\n\n - Helping refine internal processes, write documentation, and support Customer Operations initiatives, including building a self-serve experience for both external and internal users by writing and maintaining Hiive’s knowledge base.\n\n - Amplifying the voice of the customer, sharing actionable feedback with Product and Sales & Trading to advocate for enhancements.\n\n - Helping implement Hiive’s onboarding experience through lifecycle emails, education, and videos.\n\n\n\nRequired Skills:\n\n - 2-3 years of experience in a customer-facing or operational role, ideally within a SaaS or financial technology environment.\n\n - Solid technical aptitude and the ability to quickly learn and adapt to new tools, systems, and workflows.\n\n - Proactive and solution-oriented mindset, you take ownership and work with a strong sense of urgency.\n\n - Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with team members.\n\n - Curious and detail-oriented, able to spot problems or friction in workflows and suggest potential improvements.\n\n - Customer-first mentality. You are focused on understanding user needs to deliver meaningful support and solutions.\n\n - Nice to have - experience writing and maintaining content for a customer knowledge base or lifecycle communication (e.g., email campaigns).\n\n\n\nCompensation, Benefits & Perks:\n\n - Highly competitive salary commensurate with experience and contribution.\n\n - Opportunity to participate in ownership of a rapidly growing company through our employee stock option plan.\n\n - Comprehensive 100% employer-paid health & dental premiums and a Health/Personal Spending Account for Canadian employees. (An employer-subsidized benefits program is available for US-based team members).\n\n - If you are based in Vancouver, enjoy a dedicated desk in our Vancouver, BC HQ, in the heart of downtown, with a fridge stocked with healthy snacks and drinks, an onsite gym, and a gorgeous rooftop amenity.\n\n - Enjoy a $20-per-day commuter benefit for every day you work in our Vancouver HQ.\n\n - An engaging social calendar, including bi-weekly catered lunches, bi-weekly “Friday bar,” team workouts, annual summer party, and holiday party, two “onsite” all-team retreats each year, semi-annual team-building events, and Hiive Women’s Network events.\n\n - Significant opportunities for growth into team leadership and management roles.\n\n - Entrepreneurial culture and a small and dynamic team.\n\n - Sponsorship, immigration, and relocation for exceptional candidates.\n\n\n\nHiive is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all individuals have an opportunity to succeed.\n\n\n\nAI, automated tools, and applicant privacy notice:\n\nAs part of our recruitment and hiring process, Hiive may use automated tools, including artificial intelligence (AI), to assist in screening applications, evaluating candidate qualifications, and supporting interview processes. You will define the QA strategy, own the test infrastructure and processes that allow Hiive to ship with confidence, and evolve how the team operates as AI-assisted engineering reshapes the way our product is built. This is a leadership role where you'll shape both the people and the practice of quality at Hiive.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>In this role, your responsibilities would include:</strong></p><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Lead, mentor, and develop a team of 3 QA engineers, setting clear ownership areas, throughout the development lifecycle.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Track and report on defect trends, test coverage metrics, team performance, and release readiness to engineering AI-assisted engineering workflows.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Strong hands-on experience with test automation frameworks — Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or equivalent.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, CircleCI, or similar).</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Solid understanding of testing You will define the QA strategy, own the test infrastructure and processes that allow Hiive to ship with confidence, and evolve how the team operates as AI-assisted engineering reshapes the way our product is built. This is a leadership role where you'll shape both the people and the practice of quality at Hiive.\n\n\n\nIn this role, your responsibilities would include:\n\n - Lead, mentor, and develop a team of 3 QA engineers, setting clear ownership areas, performance expectations, and career growth paths.\n\n - Define and own the QA strategy end-to-end — from test planning and case design through to reporting and continuous improvement — and adapt it continuously to the changing needs of AI-enabled product engineering.\n\n - Design and maintain an automated test framework covering Hiive's core transaction, onboarding, and platform workflows.\n\n - Integrate QA into CI/CD pipelines so that quality gates are automated and regression coverage runs on every build.\n\n - Partner closely with product and engineering to review requirements, identify testability issues early, and advocate for quality throughout the development lifecycle.\n\n - Track and report on defect trends, test coverage metrics, team performance, and release readiness to engineering leadership.\n\n - Triage and investigate production issues, coordinating root cause analysis and ensuring fixes are covered by regression tests.\n\n - Evaluate and introduce new tooling, AI-assisted testing approaches, or processes as Hiive's platform and team scale.\n\n\n\nRequired skills:\n\n - 5+ years of software QA experience, with at least 2 years managing QA engineers.\n\n - Demonstrated experience defining and driving QA strategy.\n\n - Experience evolving QA practices for AI-assisted engineering workflows.\n\n - Strong hands-on experience with test automation frameworks — Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or equivalent.\n\n - Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, CircleCI, or similar).\n\n - Solid understanding of testing methodologies: functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end.\n\n - Ability to write clear test plans, test cases, and quality reports for both technical and non-technical audiences.\n\n - Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-ownership environment where you define the process, not just follow it.\n\n\n\nPreferred skills:\n\n - Experience evolving QA practices in environments where engineers use AI coding assistants (Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or similar) in their daily work.\n\n - Managing both Engineering Leads and IC engineers, including 1:1s, performance reviews, and helping each person take on more scope and grow their career.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Acting as a technical leader across both teams–shaping architecture and technical direction alongside the Engineering Lead and bringing scrutiny to significant technical decisions, while the Lead retains day-to-day technical ownership, mentorship, and accountability.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Partnering with the Director to lead and develop the broader group of Engineering Leads in the group–and, as the team grows, with a peer group of fellow Engineering Managers.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Driving prioritization discipline alongside each team's triad, championing ruthless scoping and incremental delivery of business value.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Continuously assessing team effectiveness–delivery, health, and growth trajectory–and translating that read into action.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Championing the health, stability, and operational rigor of the platform across both teams, including participation in the management on-call rotation.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Building and scaling the team through hiring as engineering grows.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Championing AI-native engineering practices–staying personally fluent with AI coding tools and driving their adoption across the team.</p></li></ul><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Required skills:</strong></p><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Extensive software engineering experience, with enough depth to genuinely evaluate your teams’ technical decisions. (This typically looks like 8+ years of hands-on experience, though we care more about demonstrated depth than a specific number.)</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">A proven track record managing engineers of different levels (including Staff) and different working styles. (This typically looks like 3+ years in a formal management role.)</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Strong IC experience building software at scale, preferably with Elixir, Ruby, or Typescript.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Effective communication across both technical and business stakeholders.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Strong track record as an engineer or manager during a period of rapid growth.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Genuinely proficient with AI-assisted coding tools, with recent hands-on experience.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-ownership environment where you define the process, not just follow it.</p></li></ul><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Preferred skills:</strong></p><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Experience in fintech, marketplace platforms, or other regulated software environments.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Experience driving AI adoption as a team-wide process change, not just personal tool use</p></li></ul><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Compensation, Benefits &amp; Perks:</strong></p><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Highly competitive salary commensurate with experience and contribution.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Opportunity to participate in ownership of a rapidly growing company through our employee stock option plan.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Comprehensive 100% employer-paid health &amp; dental premiums and a Health/Personal Spending Account for Canadian employees. (An employer-subsidized benefits program is available for US-based team members).</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">If you are based in Vancouver, enjoy a dedicated desk in our Vancouver, BC HQ, in the heart of downtown, with a fridge stocked with healthy snacks and drinks, an onsite gym, and a gorgeous rooftop amenity.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Enjoy a $20-per-day commuter benefit for every day you work in our Vancouver HQ.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">An engaging social calendar, including bi-weekly catered lunches, bi-weekly “Friday bar,” team workouts, annual summer party, and holiday party, two “onsite” all-team retreats each year, semi-annual team-building events, and Hiive Women’s Network events.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Significant opportunities for growth into team leadership and management roles.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Entrepreneurial culture and a small and dynamic team.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Sponsorship, immigration, and relocation for exceptional candidates.</p></li></ul><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Hiive is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all individuals have an opportunity to succeed.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>AI, automated tools, and applicant privacy notice:</strong></p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">As part of our recruitment and hiring process, Hiive may use automated tools, including artificial intelligence (AI), to assist in screening applications, evaluating candidate qualifications, and supporting interview processes. In any given week, you might open a conversation with a partner you've prioritized, structure a pitch around Hiive’s unique capabilities, and negotiate terms with a counterparty's leadership, all while managing production across live partners.\n\n\n\nIn this role, your responsibilities would include:\n\n - Structure proposals and negotiate terms across economics, commitments, and performance conditions.\n\n - Own agreements from redlines to signature, engaging business leaders and working in close partnership with cross-functional stakeholders.\n\n - Support national account relationships with wirehouses and wealth management firms, from diligence through firm-level agreements and platform placement.\n\n - Build the operating infrastructure of the partnership function, including diligence, contracting, onboarding, supply packaging, and flow into Hiive's sales and execution teams, hiring dedicated support as the practice scales.\n\n -
